about_the_game:
Doomspire is an epic, roguelike adventure card game set in the Doomspire, an ancient and cursed structure that spirals down into the abyss. Once a towering monument that pierced the heavens, the Doomspire now crumbles inward, its roots descending into darkness, where doom awaits all who descend. You will create your dwarven hero and venture deeper into the Doomspire, facing terrifying bosses, uncovering forgotten treasures, and battling for your very survival.

Every journey is unique, as the Doomspire is procedurally generated with new paths, dangers, and mysteries waiting to be discovered. Collect powerful cards and relics, build synergies, and adapt your strategies as you progress. But beware—the deeper you go, the darker and more perilous the journey becomes.

Key Features:

  • Procedurally Generated Depths: Each run offers a new experience, with shifting paths, enemies, and treasures in the Doomspire.

  • Strategic Deck-Building: Collect and craft a unique deck for your hero. Use synergies, abilities, and powerful cards to create your perfect strategy.

  • Sacrifice Mechanics: Trade HP, minions, and resources for greater power. Risk and reward play a key role in the Doomspire.

  • Epic Boss Fights: Confront powerful bosses, each with their own unique abilities and strategies. Overcome them to gain valuable rewards.

  • Endless Replayability: Every descent into the Doomspire is different. With multiple builds, playstyles, and synergies to explore, no two runs are ever the same.

Doomspire combines strategic deck-building with roguelike elements, where every choice matters. You’ll need to balance your resources, make tough decisions, and adapt to the ever-changing environment of the Doomspire. The core focus is on crafting powerful synergies between cards and managing sacrificial mechanics, allowing for highly dynamic gameplay and endless replayability.

  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 760 (2 GB) / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2 GB)
